method: Classical trajectory in Woods-Saxon + Coulomb potential, velocity-Verlet integration

trajectory.accumulation_definition: Outward leg: alpha moves toward Coulomb barrier, KE converts to PE (energy stored in field)
trajectory.release_definition: Inward leg: alpha moves away from barrier, PE converts to KE (stored energy released)

comparison_to_catalog.diagnosis: Original catalog used the half-life as the period and mixed it with a nuclear-timescale release, producing an astronomically large ARA. The actual oscillatory system is the alpha particle bouncing inside the nuclear potential well.
